Cc: procurement@brightwellmedical.com
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II materials for renewal + expansion

Hi Lukas —

As we get formal procurement moving for the renewal and the planned expansion (additional reserved capacity), our security team has asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an interim coverage acknowledgement (bridge letter) that covers the period until your next against-the-clock Type II is issued.

Specifically could you provide: 
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or attestation letter if report is confidential)
- Bridge letter describing the audit window covered and interim controls through the new Type II date
- A short evidence checklist we can give to our GRC (network diagrams, logging retention, KMS attestations)

Procurement timeline: we are targeting a PO by 31 Oct to hit our internal renewal window. If you can confirm availability and any required procurement legal language (SOW/terms) that would be great.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightwell Medical

Marissa / Ben / Aditya — looping you in. Brightwell (prospect->customer) is asking for the standard Type II and a bridge letter to cover our audit window for their procurement. They need materials by 31 Oct to meet their PO cutoff.

Can we:
- Marissa: pull the Type II summary we can deliver publicly (redacted if needed). If full report requires an NDA, note that and provide next steps.
- Ben: draft a bridge letter (one page) that states our latest audit period, what controls remain in place, and any change timeline for the next Type II. Use previous bridge templates but call out the Dedicated deployment SLA language.
- Aditya: produce a concise evidence checklist (1 page) covering logs/retention, KMS, SOC controls crosswalk (CCL + CC2), and sample artifact locations (links to secure drive or instructions for secure upload).

Cc'ing Sarah so procurement has visibility. Sarah, we'll aim to get a first-pass bundle by Tue 12 Oct EOD. If Brightwell needs anything earlier (e.g., a signed attestation), let us know.

Thanks — Lukas

Hi team / Sarah —

Attached is a first-pass package: 
- redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (public summary; full Type II available under NDA)
- bridge_letter_draft_v1.pdf (draft — Ben please review language on audit window and Dedicated SLA)
- procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx (simple matrix Brightwell can use to mark completed items)

Key notes:
- Audit window for our most recent Type II runs 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30; the report was issued 2027-08-10. The next Type II is scheduled for completion Q3 2028.
- Bridge letter wording currently states interim coverage from 2027-07-01 through expected Q3 2028 completion; Ben please narrow language to avoid promising a date.
- The checklist points to secure artifact locations (we will share signed access links after contract signature) and lists items we can provide immediately: system architecture diagram, encryption configuration summary, retention policies, SOC control matrix excerpts.

Sarah — can you confirm if Brightwell accepts a bridge letter that references the audit window and lists available artifacts, or do they require signed attestation on letterhead? If they require any specific procurement language (e.g., indemnity/limitations), flag it and we'll loop legal.

Next steps:
- Ben: revise bridge letter and send back to Sarah for legal review by Thu 14 Oct.
- Aditya: prepare the evidence matrix with links and expected turnaround for each artifact (estimate: 3–5 business days after contract).
- Lukas: I'll prepare a short cover email and compressed bundle for procurement.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa / Lukas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft materials. Our GRC team reviewed the summary and the checklist; they prefer the bridge letter on company letterhead with a named signatory rather than a generic attestation. They also asked that the bridge explicitly state the audit period covered and confirm there are no material control changes since the last Type II issuance.

We are comfortable proceeding to procurement prelims pending receipt of the revised bridge letter (signed) and the checklist with delivery ETA for each artifact. If we receive those items by Tue 19 Oct EOD we should be able to keep our internal PO date of 31 Oct.

I'll loop in our legal (procurement@brightwellmedical.com) if any language needs redlining.

Appreciate the help — Sarah

Brightwell Medical
